title: Immersion in the equity market hall of Exane BNP Paribas
description: Exane opened the doors of its stock market room to 9 students from HEC on Thursday, March 30 in Paris. On the program, an immersion in the sale France, corporate sale and arbitration activities where they were able to discover the professions of Exane BNP Paribas and exchange with our professionals.  Join us: https://www.exane.com

asr.full_text: The BICP – a programme for companies and trade unions A CETA Programme for the Finance and Investment Industry for the Industrial and Trading Industry I've been at Exan for 12 years now. I'm in charge of commercial strategy. It's very hard to tell a good price by work in not like when you're a financial analyst or trader, or any other other profession that's never known. It's difficult for students to know about businesses like that, so it's important for Exan for us to work with them to teach our students how to do it. I truly enjoy market finance. This is why I was interested when I was in high school. And I never really had a real experience on trading. That has taught me about the different different divisions for exxon, and I learned a lot from the cooperation. It is enriching. We've learned a lot from how to approach the sales department. Those are all very passionate about their work that can still be us for hours. It is different from clichés in that it's much less noisy. It's a mix between calm and a dynamic that is difficult to replicate elsewhere. I think I have a better idea of what is the actual work of a trader for example. They are able to tell us as much information as they could in just six week. Discovering Excellence Fun Inspiring Unique Clarifying Dynamic Exciting Challenging one clarifying dynamic exciting challenging The goal of the day was to introduce the students to sales and their business and to give them a general idea about the sales department so that they might discover new things and establish relationships with the staff which can lead us to their learnings, with their school.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents HEC students visiting Exane to learn about company professions and speak with professionals. Its purpose is educational and career-oriented, introducing sales and trading-related work through workplace learning rather than soliciting payment, investment, credentials, or other financial participation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is education about business, finance, sales and trading work through a student workplace-immersion event and conversations with professionals.
